title: The agent-environment loop
brief: Build a random agent, run it in a small grid room, and log the state, action, and reward of every step.
hints: A random policy is a table where every row holds the same probability, 1 / n_actions. np.full((n_states, n_actions), 1.0 / n_actions) builds it.
Record the state before you call mdp.step, not after. states[t], actions[t], and rewards[t] all belong to the same step.
rng.choice(mdp.n_actions, p=pi[s]) draws one action with the policy's probabilities.
Stop the loop when terminated or truncated is True. Return terminated itself, so a time-limit stop reports False.
np.bincount(states, minlength=n_states) counts how often each state appears.
